articleTitle: Effects of virtual reality-based cognitive training on cognitive function, instrumental activities of daily living, and depressive symptoms in older people with mild cognitive impairment: a systematic review with meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
takeaways: This appears to be a systematic review protocol or title only - no actual study results, effect sizes, intervention details, or quantitative findings are provided in the abstract to generate evidence-based takeaways
Without access to the full methodology, sample sizes, intervention protocols, or outcome measurements, specific actionable recommendations cannot be determined
The abstract lacks essential details about VR training duration, frequency, specific cognitive improvements measured, or statistical significance of any findings
